description: Rules for building the CSF question banks (/build-csf-bank). extract_cset_candidates.py flags each CSET question; build_csf_bank.py puts each question CSET links to a CSF 2.0 subcategory into the banks of the sectors its question set is for. After a change, run /build-csf-bank again.

truncated.description: A CSET question is flagged truncated if its text ends with one of these characters or is shorter than min_chars.

statement_only_text.description: A CSET practice with no question text (flag statement_only) is shown with the text of this CSET practice field.

sector_by_model.description: CSET question sets for one sector: their questions go only into that sector's bank. A set not listed here goes into every sector's bank.
